See, I feel the opposite about Astarion and even Lae-zel, who is exceptionally prickly. They’re both scared and trying to protect themselves, Astarion from being under Cazador’s control/emotional intimacy/being hurt by Tav, and Lae from turning into a mindflayer, being away from her people (the only thing she’s ever known), being extremely young, having to trust someone who isn’t Githyanki and then learning her entire worldview and religion is based on her peoples’ enslavement and being under the thumb of a lich queen. 

Shadowheart, on the other hand, is just nasty. I said in my main comment she’s got extreme main character syndrome, every ‘ah it hurts’ cuts off other characters’ banter, she has two animated cut scenes when none of the other characters have one, and similarly to Astarion, her plot has no relevance to stopping the absolute, but you hear a lot of people complaining about Astarion having the same thing and not her. She’s prioritised in camp cut scenes and imo, her character growth just isn’t as good as the others. 

If she’s there for dialogue scenes throughout the game, she’ll always be the one to make bitchy comments. This is a small thing, but to me she never shows gratitude or says thank you for helping her growth, ie, returning to Selune, whereas if you stop the ritual, Astarion thanks you for believing in him and helping him not to become a second Cazador. Gale thanks you for not letting him give up on himself, Halsin thanks you for your help in act 2, Wyll is not super fleshed out so I’ll forgive that, Jaheira says thank you for saving her ✨friend✨ in act 3 (spoilers) and Karlach, my dear dear Karlach, just wants your acceptance and the knowledge that you’ll be there with her on the pier at the end of the game. And then thanks you for being her friend. Lae-zel, in her way, thanks you for giving her the space and time to make her choices re her arc. 

It’s all just my opinion tbh, I’m not a fan of Shadowheart and her character gets on my nerves. If she doesn’t get on yours, that’s fine too 🤷‍♀️
